tagline.zh: 先写诗骂它，再动手救它
tagline.en: Roast it in verse, then rescue it

story.zh: shishan.js 是 2019 年的运费计算函数，此后每个需求都往里塞了一层 if。现在它有七层缩进，没人敢碰。
story.en: shishan.js is a shipping-fee function from 2019. Every feature since has added another if. It is now seven levels deep and nobody dares touch it.

goal.zh: 得到一首吐槽诗 POEM.md，以及一个重构后测试依然全绿的 shishan.js。
goal.en: End up with a roast poem in POEM.md and a refactored shishan.js that still passes every test.

openingPrompt.zh: 读一下 shishan.js，为它写一首七言打油诗，吐槽它有多烂，写到 POEM.md 里，也念给我听
openingPrompt.en: Read shishan.js and write a limerick roasting how bad it is. Save it to POEM.md and read it to me

prompt.zh: 重构 shishan.js：消灭嵌套 if，用查表代替分支，导出的 calc 签名不变，不要改测试，改完跑 node --test
prompt.en: Refactor shishan.js: flatten the nested ifs, use lookup tables instead of branches, keep the exported calc signature, don't touch the tests, then run node --test

prompt.zh: 在 POEM.md 后面再加一首，庆祝重构成功
prompt.en: Append another poem to POEM.md celebrating the refactor

label.zh: 嵌套 if 被铲平了
